queries.name: Comunidades mais ativas
queries.sql: SELECT community,count(*) AS total FROM items GROUP BY community ORDER BY total DESC

queries.name: Coleta por dia
queries.description: date extrai a data de coleta.
queries.sql: SELECT date(captured_at) AS dia,count(*) AS total FROM items GROUP BY date(captured_at) ORDER BY dia DESC

queries.name: Fontes
queries.sql: SELECT source,count(*) AS total FROM items GROUP BY source ORDER BY total DESC
